name: Diamond Head Summit Trail
region: Diamond Head State Monument, Oahu, Hawaii
why: Through a tunnel into the crater and up stairs and old army bunkers to the rim, with Waikiki and Honolulu spread below.
book: Reservation required for visitors from outside Hawaii (entry and parking, gostateparks.hawaii.gov), up to 30 days ahead. Open 6:00-18:00.
water: None on the trail: carry 1 litre, it is hot and exposed.
dangers: Steep stairs and a narrow dark tunnel.

points.name: Diamond Head crater trailhead
points.note: The parking inside the crater, reached by a road tunnel.

points.name: Diamond Head summit
points.note: Leahi, the crater's high point over Waikiki and the ocean.
